releaseNotes: Installer: the bootstrap latest-check now works - the updater's dependency closure (Core, Newtonsoft) is extracted with it, so the online resolve is no longer a silent no-op.
Installer: a newer remote release is swapped in right after the base install; the uninstaller survives the swap.
Installer: silent installs no longer show bootstrap message boxes; downgrade refusal is fully logged.
Updater: packages whose payload version does not match the manifest/job version are refused (version-floor integrity).

WBS View (Create WBS View): planner-useful sheet with activity rows, durations, floats, real date/number formats, autofilter, freeze panes and optional outline groups; activity rows never inherit WBS colors.
WBS to HTML: new Gantt on/off, baseline bar toggle and zoom controls.
HTML Dashboard: executive KPIs completed (duration, WBS count, float<=0 activities, actual/planned progress); fixed a click-error on the dashboard pages.
